description: Client-side script for the 'Dunning' doctype in ERPNext, managing form setup, validation, and actions related to overdue invoices and dunning process.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures query filters for sales_invoice and income_account fields on form setup.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh actions, including setting read-only properties, adding buttons, and routing.

methods.name: overdue_days
methods.description: Fetches dunning type based on overdue days and updates related fields.

methods.name: dunning_type
methods.description: Triggers retrieval of dunning letter text when dunning type changes.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Triggers retrieval of dunning letter text when language changes.

methods.name: get_dunning_letter_text
methods.description: Calls server method to get dunning letter content and updates form fields.

methods.name: due_date
methods.description: Triggers calculation of overdue days based on due date.

methods.name: posting_date
methods.description: Triggers calculation of overdue days based on posting date.

methods.name: rate_of_interest
methods.description: Triggers calculation of interest and total amount when rate of interest changes.

methods.name: outstanding_amount
methods.description: Triggers calculation of interest and total amount when outstanding amount changes.

methods.name: interest_amount
methods.description: Triggers calculation of interest and total amount when interest amount changes.

methods.name: dunning_fee
methods.description: Triggers calculation of interest and total amount when dunning fee changes.

methods.name: sales_invoice
methods.description: Triggers overdue days calculation when sales invoice changes.

methods.name: calculate_overdue_days
methods.description: Calculates overdue days based on posting and due dates.

methods.name: calculate_interest_and_amount
methods.description: Calculates interest amount, dunning amount, and grand total based on current data.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a payment entry and redirects to its form.
